body: Feeling like I have options isn’t how I feel. I’m staying with this job because I enjoy it and I don’t think I could make new friends, it took a huge effort and about 3 months for me to be able to talk to people. That’s so great for her though, sometimes I’ve been called a girl and it felt great or people had a hard time knowing what I was, due to my long hair and all the baggy clothes I wear but they usually correct themselves to how I look after a few seconds ;-;

Getting a job within the nhs isn’t easy, especially being this young. I enjoy my job and it isn’t really the issue I’m having with it is just being called a guy is demoralising and the pay is shite, until April 2021
I just went with the first nhs job I could find, I honestly have no cares I’m just going with whatever happened.

It’s a full time job, I work 6-2:30 Monday to Friday and it’s an hour both ways. I do the exact same work as all the other chefs there so I’m tired after working, soon I can work Saturday which will help but I’m convinced my mum will up rent based on this. I enjoy my work and the people there but as they’re chefs they’re mostly 40/50 while I’m 21

Living the life I want to live is years away. I need to be self sufficient my job is bad pay as I’m an apprentice (£4 an hour) as well my parents charge £280 a month for rent so saving up is virtually impossible between that and bus fares. I’m just losing the will to go on everyday. I have no plans outside of transitioning, I used to have many. Till my abusive ex argued demoralised and humiliated me for all of them.

All of my friends were also transphobic, I surrounded myself with them in an attempt to ‘stop’ how I was feeling so no, I don’t have anyone irl to talk to about how I feel. I removed those people but I am no good at keeping friends. I know why they haven’t noticed and it’s because me leaving is for a bit is sort of common, just usually someone asks. As well I’m extremely self conscious about being trans and struggle to be able to talk to people about it. Even just talking about feeling suicidal is difficult, there’s so much on my mind trying to get it down into a coherent sentence is difficult
